proof_obligations.PO-PSD: Saturate orthogonal classes under every selected and full translation equality; the resulting 0/1 Gram matrix is exactly PSD with unit diagonal and checked rank.
proof_obligations.PO-NONEXTENSION: Perfect native pair moments at a unit difference basis force any representing character distribution to secret0, contradicting zero native anchors. This is pointwise, not random-source noisy inference hardness.
proof_obligations.PO-SEPARATION: Weighted native-harmonic score has exact integrality gap2m*w for0<w<=1/(m*q^2). Secret0 attains the true optimum; a chord-distance bound rules out every nonzero secret without exponential enumeration. This is not the native noisy likelihood objective.
proof_obligations.PO-REPAIR: Explicit difference anchors, balanced unit-basis row reconstruction, conjugation, addition and q-loops compile in polynomial size. Gram error propagation proves B<=C*A at any PSD rank. The selected diagnostic is tight when w*C<1.
proof_obligations.PO-RESIDUAL: For exact PSD/unit diagonal and selected complex equality residuals at most tau, beta_j=6*sum(abs(lambda_j))+1 and E=sum(beta_j^2) give B<=(sqrt(C*A)+sqrt(E*tau))^2. Weighted diagnostic excess is at most w*E*tau/(1-w*C). Floating PSD and diagonal premises remain uncertified.
proof_obligations.PO-NOISE: Native noise first harmonics are1/3, not near1; the coefficient-weighted saturation bound can be vacuous. Native likelihood tightness, planted recovery and efficient decoding remain unproved.
proof_obligations.PO-ACCESS: No oracle queries, hidden-secret selection, physical IID guarantee, free postselection or quantum LWE examples are introduced.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independent mathematical review and a costed decoder/quantum implementation are still needed. These exact native representation controls are not an accepted algorithm candidate.

falsifiable_experiments: A partition Gram matrix fails any full equal-frequency equality or its difference basis is not invertible at the retained root.
A true character exceeds the rational separating score maximum.
A feasible repaired Gram matrix violates B<=C*A or exceeds the repaired weighted diagnostic optimum.
Saturated basis pair moments leave any native anchor inconsistent with the same character.
A native noisy high-rank likelihood optimum cannot be rounded, or the source/noise error makes the saturation bound vacuous.
